0022600216.text: The Trail Blazers (6-3) host the Thunder (8-2) in Portland's 10th game of the season, with Portland on a two-game losing streak and sitting 1.5 games back of the Northwest lead, while Oklahoma City is on a four-game winning streak and leads the division. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), and Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet this season, but Portland lost 1-3 to Oklahoma City in the 2025-26 season series, including a 124-95 loss in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025.
